Winner's decklist:

Deck Name : Enkidu PRO CEL
Author : Vincent Ripoll
Description :
I got some inspiration from Aleksi Nuora's TWD to build this one. Protean and Celerity are great costless polyvalent combat disciplines (there are only 3 Claws that cost blood amongst the 60 combat cards). I playtested and tweaked it lots of time during our weekly session (thanks to my patient victims) and I'm quite happy about it.
Aleksi's version used some "bad" cards from my point of view and is quite vulnerable to many threats. I'm a safe player. So I included many countermeasures to make sure Enkidu's don't get crushed by some Warghouls, pentex of Tempted by Greater Powers... The deck handles almost everything in combat, so if you end up in torpor, it's likely a misplay.
As always, the deck is quite vulnerable during the first few turns until Enkidu gets out. Blood Dolls shouldn't be neglected in pool recovery, you don't have any other (apart from the Enkil's Cog trick to bleed during your predator's turn).
You can have a reliable multi-rush as soon as you get Enkil Cog. There's always a way to untap (Earth Meld, Sense the Savage Way or the permanent Monster/Homunculus) so it's MUCH more easier when you have the Enkil. Otherwise, try to draw your rush cards or block with Sense the Savage Way.

The oust power comes mainly from Andre's special and Enkil Cog. No Fame, no Dragonbound because they tend to slow the cardflow and aren't really necessary.

Crypt [13 vampires] Capacity min: 1 max: 11 average: 6.30769
6x Enkidu, The Noah 11 ANI CEL OBF POT PRO for !Gangrel:4
2x Andre LeRoux 3 aus Toreador:5
1x T.J. 3 cel for Gangrel:4
1x Clifton Derrik 2 cel Brujah:4
1x Leo Washington 2 cel pro !Gangrel:4
1x Sean Andrews 2 cel Toreador:4
1x Iris Bennett 1 pro Caitiff:5

Enkidu in 5 copies sometimes didn't show up. I added one copy (with a 13-crypt card to draw more side-kicks)

Library [90 cards]
Action [8]
1x Aranthebes, The Immortal -> as always, to contest or to give me some protection against weenie decks (or even intercept... it's a great card)
1x Bum's Rush
1x Deep Song
1x Heroic Might -> makes some combat easier, but is not vital
2x Rumble
1x Sense Death
1x Taunt the Caged Beast

Action Modifier [2]
2x Enkil Cog -> allows permanent multirush and can give the edge during's your predator's turn. The +1 bleed is great also. Really a key card.

Combat [59]
3x Canine Horde -> why play Drawing when you can get rid of that Ivory Bow/.44 Magnum or Heart of Nizchetus?
3x Claws of the Dead -> should always be used to burn vampires. Can get rid of Ponticulus/Tye/Ambrosius
9x Earth Meld -> defensive, untap, works well with Psyche! and is free. Can't ask more
2x Flesh of Marble -> cycles easily, handles War Ghoul/Carrion/.44 blur etc.
16x Psyche! -> key card, even 16 are sometimes not enough
11x Pursuit
2x Skin of Steel
4x Stutter-Step -> saves slots, can be used by the sidekicks to dodge
9x Taste of Vitae

Equipment [1]
1x Gran Madre di Dio, Italy -> against Tupdogs, Nocturns...

Master [12]
4x Blood Doll -> slow pool gain and blood management to feed Enkidu.
1x Guardian Angel -> the permanent "prevent 1" is a real life saver.
1x Monster -> permanent untap
1x Pentex(TM) Subversion -> for contest or to lock an annoying minion (Ponticulus or the guy with the gun). Can also slow down your predator when you don't have Enkidu yet)
2x Sudden Reversal -> To be kept against Pentex, Temptation of Greater Power etc.
3x Wider View
Master come quite quickly because you cycle lots of cards. You can even jam with master even there are only 11 of them, but it's quite rare.

Reaction [6]
6x Sense the Savage Way -> to block of course, but protects also against Rötschreck/Mind Numb/Sensory Deprivation

Retainer [2]
1x Homunculus -> not vital, but useful once you have Enkil Cog
1x Raven Spy -> helpful, but not vital.

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
This deck impresses me. its not the first I've seen, but the fact that an 11 cap wrecking ball with 40 combat cards and 17 defensive cards of those, can multi act and crush ready regions when there were other combat decks present impresses me.

I'm very curious about Vincent moreau's g6 cel guns as well. there's good vamps with cel in g 5 and 6, but I've always used g 4 to support 5 instead of 6, basically to use more midcaps. I'm intrigued.

Messages.Author: Kiddo
Messages.Body: I have a question...how does Enkidu survive opposing combats, mainly aggropoke (considering that he's usually an acting minion)? Is a single Guardian Angel enough, or is it not an issue in that particular meta?

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
I thought that too, since there's only a couple fortitude cards, and enky is a big rush target in Ohio playgroup since he only has little fortitude. but there are stutter steps and earth melds enough in this deck to probably survive anything agg poke other than grapple agg poke. now, in the report cel guns, animalism and grapple potence are all listed, but what this deck is weak against is high damage output with fortitude and grapple. Cock robin could torp enky with a rush, some pres a grapple or 3 and maybe 2 fortitude cards.
beefcake or hardestadt could use just grapple, fortitude, disarm, then possibly freak drive and graverob.
they key is those kinds of decks are not as commons other combat, and the only agg that can routinely get thru to torp enky is rotshreck reliant decks. in metas where combat is common, there's always a chance someone is playing this decks trump, but its certainly not even a garuntee then.

I'm just surprised there's no sideslip or adaptability. well, the latter of those kinda sucks, but this deck has a really diverse defensive combat package for being a very offensive combat deck. Stutter step is just funny for 3 possibly agg.

Guardian angel, weapon destruction, 2 skins of steel, 4 stutter step. That's a lot of thing that can foil you.
>
> Kiddo wrote:
> Maybe I'm reading too much into this, but it seems to me that way too many clans have access to aggro damage (any Gangrel, Tzimisce, even any Tremere via Flames of the Nethervoid, if we're discussing first round agg damage, Baali (and particulary the unnamed decks), Assamite, Gargoyle...) for this not to be an issue. Enkidu really can't afford ending up in torpor...
>
Problem is, aggravated damage tend to not be too efficient in combat. It doesn't prevent hitback, so by itself it's most often 2 blood vs 2 blood in blood management term : 1 for doing aggravated, 1 because of hitback. Compare to .44 (once setup, 0 blood vs 2), Carrion crow (1 blood vs 2 blood), Torn Signpost (1 blood vs 3 blood), etc ...

The true value of aggravated is that the vampire is in torpor, ripe for destruction (but cross table rescues, or even sidekick rescue, can ruin your day), and the lost action. But it's just not enough to be that good most of the time.

That's why people play animalism combat and not aggropoke. Burning blood is way more reliable and less easy to deal with than torpor.
